title: 第7章 手替面试-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    更衣室里，韩小汐手机振动，是刘超，她连忙接通。

    “你人呢？！快收工了！快过来！”

    “刘导，我就来。”

    换好衣服，热源立马少了一大半，韩小汐也无暇顾及尴不尴尬，直接将衣服塞到了郭炜手里，“帮我谢谢沈老师。”

    说完，头也不回地往片场冲。

    ……

    户外片场，打戏。

    韩小汐和刘超站在一处等着于清收工。

    她以前听说，沈珩的打戏从来不用替身，也没有什么慢动作之类的。

    她当初还以为是媒体美化包装的完美人设。

    如今在现场看着拳拳到肉的打斗场景，只感慨有些人成功是注定的。

    就刚刚那个躲避下腰的角度，完全是专业级别的。

    别说还能立马起身接下一个跃身刺剑的动作。

    行云流水，一气呵成。

    刘超看着都碎碎念起来，“都说影帝片酬高，其实他才是真正的性价比之王！啧啧！”

    终于，于清激动地喊了卡，“收工。”

    沈珩随意地挽了个剑花收剑。

    应该是下意识的动作，韩小汐却看直了眼，比刚刚的打戏还吸引人。

    直到刘超喊她，她才回神。

    “还不快跟我过来。”

    ……

    沈珩刚放下手里的道具剑，郭炜就拎着外套跑了过来。

    “怎么在你这儿？”他微微拧眉，但还是套上了衣服。

    郭炜一愣，“额，韩小姐还给我的。”看老板似乎不开心，他连忙补了一句，“她说谢谢你。”

    “嗯。”沈珩没回头，和工作人员打招呼，下班。

    远远的瞥见一个小小的身影被刘超带去了于清那边。

    还没走？

    “老板，杰睿哥来接你了。”

    “嗯。我去跟导演打个招呼。”沈珩说着也往于清那边走去。

    ……

    “小汐是吧，表现不错。刘导，别忘了给人孩子结工资。”于清提前完成拍摄任务，心情很是不错。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the locker room, Han Xiaoxi's phone vibrated. It was Liu Chao, and she quickly answered the call.

"Where are you?! It's almost time to finish the work! Come here quickly!"

"Director Liu, I'm coming."

After changing clothes, the heat source was reduced by more than half. Han Xiaoxi had no time to worry about embarrassment and directly stuffed the clothes into Guo Wei's hands, "Thank you, Teacher Shen, for me."

After saying that, he rushed to the set without looking back.

……

​​ Outdoor studio, fighting scenes.

Han Xiaoxi and Liu Chao stood together waiting for Yu Qing to finish work.

She had heard before that Shen Heng never used a body double in his fighting scenes, and there was no slow motion or anything like that.

At first she thought it was a perfect persona for the media to beautify and package.

Now, watching the fist-to-flesh fight scene at the scene, I just feel that some people are destined to succeed.

The angle of avoiding the waist just now is completely professional level.

Not to mention that he could stand up immediately and take the next leap to stab the sword.

The flow of clouds and flowing water is done in one go.

Liu Chao looked at it and started thinking, "They all say that movie stars are paid well, but in fact he is the real king of cost-effectiveness! Tsk tsk!"

Finally, Yu Qing shouted excitedly, "It's over."

Shen Heng casually held a sword flower and sheathed his sword.

It should be a subconscious action, but Han Xiaoxi looked straight at it, which was more attractive than the fight scene just now.

She didn’t come back to her senses until Liu Chao called her.

"Come with me quickly."

……

As soon as Shen Heng put down the prop sword in his hand, Guo Wei ran over with his coat.

"Why are you here?" He frowned slightly, but still put on his clothes.

Guo Wei was stunned, "Well, Miss Han gave it back to me." Seeing that the boss seemed unhappy, he quickly added, "She said thank you."

"Yeah." Shen Heng didn't look back. He greeted the staff and got off work.

I saw a small figure from a distance being taken to Yu Qing by Liu Chao.

Not leaving yet?

"Boss, Brother Jerry is here to pick you up."

"Well. I'm going to say hello to the director." Shen Heng said and walked towards Yu Qing.

……

"Xiao tide, right? You performed well. Director Liu, don't forget to pay your children's wages." Yu Qing completed the filming task ahead of schedule and was in a good mood.
